# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_PULLBACK_LONG

## Hypothesis

In an uptrend, price tends to find support at VWAP when the short‑term EMA (9) aligns with the mid‑term EMA (20) and both sit above the long‑term EMA (50), offering a high‑probability long entry on a bounce. This edge exists because institutional algorithms often use VWAP as a benchmark, and EMA ribbon alignment confirms trend strength, making pullbacks to VWAP high-probability continuation spots.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the 9‑EMA > 20‑EMA > 50‑EMA (ribbon bullish alignment) and the price pulls back to touch VWAP (low ≤ VWAP ≤ high) on a bar, then enter long at the close of that bar if the close > VWAP and volume > 1.2× the 20‑period average volume. Exit: Initial stop placed at the lowest low of the prior 3 bars (chart‑stop); take profit 1 at 1.5× ATR from entry, runner trailed by a 15‑percentage‑point chandelier exit. Regime hint: Best when VIX is between 12‑22 (moderate volatility) and time‑of‑day after 10:00 ET (avoid first 30 min); avoid strong down‑trend days where ribbon is bearish.
